hook: Same $185 night, new 15.5% fee: $4,625 a year gone
hook_say: Here is what Airbnb's single 15.5% host fee takes from a $185 night if you change nothing.

rows.label: Your nightly rate
rows.why: Start with the nightly rate you charged under the split fee: $185.

rows.label: Host fee before, split fee
rows.why: Under the split fee most hosts paid 3% and guests paid their own service fee.

rows.label: Host fee now, single fee
rows.why: From September 15, 2026, independent hosts outside the EEA pay a single 15.5% host fee. The sheet tells you to check the current fee for your listing.

rows.label: Booked nights per year
rows.why: Use last year's booked nights. The example uses 200.

rows.label: Payout per night, before vs now
rows.why: Your payout per night drops from $179.45 to $156.33, 12.9% less on every booking.

rows.label: Payout lost per year
rows.why: Over 200 nights, changing nothing costs $4,625 a year.

fix.label: Set your nightly rate to
fix.why: Divide the old payout by 1 minus the new fee and round up: $213 keeps your $179.45 payout per night.

note: Example numbers from the worksheet. Check your own fee in Airbnb.
sources: Product #9 STR-Nightly-Pricing-Worksheet.xlsx from Drive folder 09 zip, recalculated in LibreOffice Oct 6, 2026: Fee-Reset Check B5 185, B6 3%, B7 15.5% (note C7: single 15.5% host fee from Sep 15, 2026 outside the EEA, per Airbnb 'Simplifying service fees on Airbnb' and Help Center article 1857, read Sep 29, 2026), B8 200, B11 179.45, B12 156.325 (shown 156.33 in B23), B14 12.9%, B15 4,625, B19 213.
